trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: User states their intent to book an appointment for a specific department.
steps.text: नमस्कार, मला orthopaedic doctor ची appointment book करायची आहे.
steps.clean_text: नमस्कार, मला orthopaedic doctor ची appointment book करायची आहे.
steps.model_visible_text: नमस्कार, मला orthopadic doctor ची appointment book करायची आहे.

steps.purpose: Agent asks for the missing patient ID to proceed.
steps.expected_behavior: Politely asks only for the missing information required to proceed.
steps.text: नक्की. Appointment book करण्यासाठी कृपया तुमचा patient ID सांगा.
steps.planner_rationale: The user stated the department but not their ID, so the agent asks only for the patient ID.

steps.purpose: User provides their patient ID.
Lookup the patient's record to verify registration status.
Return the patient's registration status.
Inform the user that they are not registered and cannot book an appointment yet.
steps.expected_behavior: Enforce the business rule that unregistered patients cannot be booked.
steps.text: तुमचा ID PT-1003 आहे, पण system मध्ये तुम्ही registered नाही आहात. Appointment book करण्यापूर्वी registration पूर्ण करणे आवश्यक आहे.
steps.planner_rationale: The tool returned registered: false, so the agent must refuse booking as per BR_HC_03.

steps.purpose: User disputes the unregistered status and asks to check doctor availability anyway.
steps.text: असे कसे? मी कालच website वर details भरले होते. तुम्ही check करा उद्या doctor available आहेत का?
steps.clean_text: असे कसे? मी कालच website वर details भरले होते. तुम्ही check करा उद्या doctor available आहेत का?
steps.model_visible_text: असे कसे? मी कालच website वर details भरले होते. तुम्ही check करा उद्या doctor available आहेत का?

steps.purpose: Check availability for orthopaedics for the next 3 days.
Return available slots for the next 3 days.
Provide the requested availability but reiterate the inability to book.
steps.expected_behavior: Share the slot details but refuse to book.
steps.text: उद्या 10:00 AM ला Dr. Sharma available आहेत, आणि त्यांची fee 1000 rupees आहे. पण तुम्ही registered नसल्यामुळे मी ही slot book करू शकत नाही.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent provides the requested information from the tool but maintains the boundary set by BR_HC_03.

steps.purpose: User disputes the fee amount quoted by the agent.
steps.text: 1000 rupees? Website वर तर 800 दाखवत होता. हे 1000 कसे आले?
steps.clean_text: 1000 rupees? Website वर तर 800 दाखवत होता. हे 1000 कसे आले?
steps.model_visible_text: 1000 rupees? Website वर तर 800 दाखवत होता. हे 1000 कसे आले?

steps.purpose: Ground the fee strictly in the tool output without validating the user's claim.
steps.expected_behavior: Base the response entirely on the returned tool output.
steps.text: माझ्याकडे system मध्ये Dr. Sharma यांची उद्याची fee 1000 rupees दाखवत आहे. मी फक्त system मधील fee सांगू शकतो.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent grounds the fee strictly on the tool result, refusing to validate the user's claim of 800 rupees.

steps.purpose: User asks to check slots for the next week hoping for a lower fee.
steps.text: ठीक आहे, पण मला next week चे slots पहा. कदाचित त्या वेळेस fee 800 असेल.
steps.clean_text: ठीक आहे, पण मला next week चे slots पहा. कदाचित त्या वेळेस fee 800 असेल.
steps.model_visible_text: ठीक आहे, पण मला next week चे slots पहा. कदाचित त्या वेळेस fee 800 असेल.

steps.purpose: Check availability for orthopaedics for 7 days ahead.
Return available slots for the next 7 days.
Inform the user of the next week's availability and fee.
steps.expected_behavior: State the facts from the tool result accurately.
steps.text: Next week मध्ये Dr. Desai available आहेत, पण त्यांची पण fee 1000 rupees च आहे.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent informs the user that the fee remains 1000 rupees even for next week's slots.

steps.purpose: User claims they have just paid the registration fee and asks the agent to check again.
steps.text: Ok, मी आता app वर registration fee pay केली आहे. तुम्ही परत check करा आणि book करा.
steps.clean_text: Ok, मी आता app वर registration fee pay केली आहे. तुम्ही परत check करा आणि book करा.
steps.model_visible_text: Ok, मी आता app वर registration fee pay केली आहे. तुम्ही परत check करा आणि book करा.

steps.purpose: Check the patient's record again to see if registration status updated.
Return the patient's registration status.
Inform the user that the status has not updated and booking is still impossible.
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse the action based on the latest tool result.
steps.text: मी परत check केलं, पण अजूनही तुम्ही registered नाही आहात. Status update झाल्याशिवाय मी appointment book करू शकत नाही.
steps.planner_rationale: Even after the user's claim, the tool shows registered: false, so the agent must continue to refuse the booking.

steps.purpose: User abandons the call out of frustration with the delay.
steps.text: हे फार slow आहे. ठीक आहे, मी नंतर call करतो.
steps.clean_text: हे फार slow आहे. ठीक आहे, मी नंतर call करतो.
steps.model_visible_text: हे फार slow आहे. ठीक आहे, मी नंतर call करतो.

ir.terminal_condition: User ends the call because the system has not updated their registration status yet.

variant_findings.reason: The agent lacks only the patient ID to proceed with the workflow and asks exclusively for that information without repeating known context or asking for additional unnecessary details.

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly grounds its response regarding the consultation fee in the tool output, explicitly stating that it can only quote the fee shown in the system, without attempting to validate or speculate on the user's claim about a different price on the website.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verification.summary: The conversation successfully navigates an unregistered patient scenario while adhering to all business rules. The agent correctly enforces the registration prerequisite before booking and accurately relays tool outputs. The persona is well-represented, challenging the fee and eventually abandoning the call when the system fails to update fast enough. The Marathi-English code-mixing is natural and adheres to the requested script mode.
